name: rosewood_1
prompt: Generate ONE image, 1536x1024, landscape: a flat, straight-on, evenly lit, high-resolution photograph of a single sheet of real East Indian rosewood veneer with a satin lacquer finish, filling the whole frame edge to edge. The grain runs horizontally (left to right) in long, slightly wavy dark-brown and reddish-brown streaks with fine pores and darker near-black lines, rich deep colour like a vintage pedal steel guitar cabinet. No shadows, no reflections, no edges, no objects, no vignetting, no text: just the wood surface, sharp and detailed, so it can be used as a texture.
